archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast with Archetype 7 Electric Accents
design_philosophy: A 100x better, futuristic mobile IDE. Swiss brutalist structure for maximum coding clarity, mixed with high-energy neon cyber accents for AI interactions and actions. 'The command center in your pocket.'

bottom_tabs.style: Solid matte charcoal (#0F0F0F) with top border (#2A2A2A), height 72px, plus bottom safe area.
bottom_tabs.active_state: Icon tint #E5FF00 with a subtle top-border indicator inside the tab.

buttons.primary: Background #E5FF00, Text #000000, flat (no shadow), font-bold uppercase

file_tree.folder_icon: Folder icon (filled for open, outlined for closed)

ai_chat_bubble.user: Align right, Background #1A1A1A, Text #FFFFFF, border radius 12px (bottom-right 2px)
ai_chat_bubble.ai: Align left, Background transparent, Border-left 2px #E5FF00, Text #FFFFFF
ai_chat_bubble.code_snippet: Nested inside AI bubble, Background #050505, Header with 'Copy' & 'Apply' actions

splash.layout: Center aligned logo 'ZipForge' in Outfit font-black, subtle loading animation (terminal cursor), background image with heavy black overlay

projects_home.header: Title 'Forge', big and bold. Top right: Settings icon.
projects_home.hero_action: Large dashed-border card for 'Import ZIP' with a glowing plus icon.
projects_home.list: Recent projects in a flat list. Title, last edited time, tech stack tags.

file_explorer.layout: Header with project name. Scrollable list of files with collapsible folders. Tap a file to open in Editor.

code_editor.header: File name, save status, 'Preview' and 'AI' quick actions.
code_editor.body: Syntax highlighted text input (JetBrains Mono). No line wrap by default, horizontal scroll.

live_preview.layout: Full screen WebView. Floating action button (FAB) to switch back to code or refresh.

ai_assistant.layout: Chat interface. Bottom input with Voice Input button prominently displayed.
ai_assistant.voice_input_active: Modal/BottomSheet with a pulsating neon ring (#E5FF00) indicating listening state.

snippets_library.layout: Grid or list of offline templates (e.g., 'React Native Boilerplate', 'Three.js Starter'). Card styling with subtle 1px borders.

settings.layout: Standard mobile settings list (Theme, Editor Font Size, AI Model Selection, Local Storage usage).

testing.instructions: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, and list items MUST include a 'testID' (React Native equivalent of data-testid) formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Native primitives (View, Text, TextInput, ScrollView, FlatList, TouchableOpacity).
DO NOT use web-only elements like <div>, <span>, or standard web CSS.
For styling, you can use NativeWind if configured, or standard React Native StyleSheet matching the color hexes and spacing defined above.
All navigation should use React Navigation (Bottom Tabs, Stack, Modals).
For the Code Editor, implement a specialized TextInput or a third-party RN code editor component that supports syntax highlighting.
Make sure to apply the 'testID' prop to all interactable elements for automated testing.
